TUTORIALS.title: How to Make Animated Cartoon Videos with AI (Full Guide)
TUTORIALS.titleZh: AI 卡通短片：用角色参考板保持四场戏连续
TUTORIALS.learnZh: 先做角色和场景参考板，再逐场做有对白的侦探故事；把上一场成片作为连续性参考，最后到 CapCut 剪接。包含 OpenArt 赞助演示。
TUTORIALS.learnEn: Build character and set references, make a dialogue detective story scene by scene, carry earlier footage into the next scene as a continuity reference, then assemble in CapCut. OpenArt-sponsored demo.

TUTORIALS.learnZh: 先整理人物与场景素材，用 480p 做测试，再由人挑镜头并补有差异的机位，最后才把额度花在选中的镜头上。作者附 Claude Skills 链接；节省额度是作者说法。
TUTORIALS.learnEn: Organise assets, draft at 480p, choose takes and vary camera coverage by hand before spending credits on finalists. Creator links Claude Skills; savings are self-reported.

TUTORIALS.creator: Roboverse
TUTORIALS.title: How to Make AI Short Films Better than 99% of People
TUTORIALS.titleZh: AI 短片全流程：从剧本和参考图到剪辑
